title: Metric definition
description: The single shared metric-definition record (standard 1.0.0). It describes a metric: what it means, who owns it, its grain and unit, and where its deterministic rule lives. It never holds calculated values; those use the reserved MTV prefix and are defined by the owning repository. Examples are illustrative examples.

grain.description: What one value describes, for example one project per month.

unit.description: For example hours, count, ratio, or rate (0 to 1).

deterministic_rule_or_formula_reference.description: Where the deterministic rule or formula is defined: a repository path, optionally with a key.

source_entities.description: Entity names, registered in standard/id-registry.yaml, that the metric is computed from.

examples.name: load_ratio
examples.description: Demand hours divided by supply hours for one role and period. Above 1 means more work than available hours.
